newsitem.title: USA: IVAX Corp names Bethune as President and COO.
newsitem.headline: IVAX Corp names Bethune as President and COO.

text.p: IVAX Corp said on Wednesday it appointed David Bethune as president and chief operating officer.
Bethune replaces Robert Strauss, who resigned last week.

Bethune most recently was president and CEO of Aesgen Inc, a Wilmington, North Carolina-based start-up pharmaceutical company since 1995 and previously, he was a group vice presdident in charge of the worldwide pharmaceutical business for American Cyanamid Co, a subsidiary of American Home Products Corp.
In March, Bergen Brunswig Corp filed a lawsuit against IVAX after Bergen called off its $1.6 billion takeover of IVAX.
IVAX markets skin care products, generic drugs and diagnostic kits.
